contracts.boundary: The verification workflow keeps a single required release-gates check that waits for every required stage: the head-acceptance job runs the seven release gates with two concurrent lanes, the proposed-merge acceptance and the CRAP trend refresh run as parallel jobs beside it, finalize-report joins the uploaded artifacts and renders the candidate report even when a gate fails, and the release-gates check job fails closed when any stage fails or is cancelled. The report publisher runs only in finalize-report, and merge-controller binds provenance to the unique evidence-upload step name across every job of the run.
contracts.assertions: Structure witnesses pin exactly one release-gates job, the beside-runs of acceptance-merge and crap-trend, finalize-report joining artifacts, preflight-before-gates ordering, and bounded gate budgets; a fault control turns a 45-minute release-gates budget red and another turns a failed stage into a red required check. The partition-integrity check in verify-release fails closed if lane membership drifts from the declared required gates, and the manifest gates stay in declaration order. Concurrent lanes share one pack lock: the router-build gate and every npm pack/prepack serialize on it so dist/router is never rebuilt while another pack reads it. Acceptance tracks each spawned child independently so concurrent lane children are terminated and reported individually.

boundaryTest.name: the proposed-merge acceptance runs beside release-gates

invariant.name: finalize-report joins the parallel evidence into the candidate report

fault.name: fault control: a 45-minute release-gates budget turns the named budget assertion red
